name: Palladous-Howe

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by dead riverbeds and dry ocean basins and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
At the derelict space station in orbit, the toolmarks are still half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
For traders, platinum alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
